QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Delfinos? More Like Dead Fishos.
QuestInfo.0: It seems these 'Delfinos' have become a thorn in San Commerci's side. You should look into it.
QuestInfo.1: It seems these 'Delfinos' have become a thorn in San Commerci's side. You talked to Leon for answers.
QuestInfo.2: Who are these Delfinos that live beneath the San Commerci canals? It sounds like there's been friction ever since the port started growing. Leon said he was going to 'take care' of them. You decided to help him, since he's your friend.

0.0: You'd like more information on the Delfinos?

yes.0: We lived a good life alongside the Delfinos. Most of our merchants rarely interacted with them, but there was no hostility.
yes.1: San Commerci was nothing but a small fishing village in the early days of the Republic. We fished our area of the seas, they fished theirs... but then the spice trade began and this port doubled in size overnight.
yes.2: I'm sure the Delfinos are only upset because our town has prospered without them. It's the only rational explanation to their transition into roving gangs of bandits.
yes.3: The Delfinos must be treated with a firm and swift hand. It's the only thing they'll respect.
